paragraphs: I started learning web development because I wanted to understand how websites are built and how ideas can turn into real products. Since then, I've been building projects with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
Over time, I started working with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB as well, which helped me understand the full journey from a user interface to the backend behind it.
I enjoy building clean interfaces, solving problems, and learning by building real projects.
